thread:
Marta: Quick FYI before I hand off — seeing oscillating alerts across encoder-pool and routing layer. Not an incident, but noisy enough to affect oncall fatigue. Leaving a short watchlist + suggested suppressions.

Leo: Can you list the alert names and where to look? link to dashboards?

Marta: Sure — main ones: encoder_pool_alloc_failures (low-sev, repeated bursts), routing/fallback-rate spike (95th tail), and kv_autoscale_flapping in eu-west. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.dev/d/encoders/encoder-pool and https://dash.redwood.dev/d/infra/kv-autoscale. Quick metric I was watching: `sum(rate(encoder_pool_alloc_failures[5m]))` — spikes align with canary traffic.

Olivia: I'm covering the midnight slot. I can mute the KV alert if it's just flapping from the canary. What's your suggested window?

Marta: 30m suppression for kv_autoscale_flapping unless it sustains >10 errors/min. Also add a silent annotation on the chart marking the canary start time. If the encoder alloc failures continue beyond 45m escalate to infra.

Kai: Are there active deploys? I see a canary in eu-west.

DeployBot: Deploy started: model-redwood/v2.1 — canary — region=eu-west — user=marta — 2026-03-16T22:10:12Z

Marta: Yep, that canary looks correlated. No rollback planned yet. It seems like short-lived memory pressure on a subset of encoder hosts — likely a combo of traffic spike + canary.

Leo: I'll add a short handoff note in the coverage doc and create a watchlist entry under 'signal-flares' so future handoffs see it. Also will ping infra to check KV autoscale thresholds (cc @infra-team).

Olivia: I will: 1) mute `kv_autoscale_flapping` for 30m using the mute command below, 2) watch encoder alloc failures for 45m, 3) escalate if sustained.

Olivia: ```
# mute command (ops-bot)
/mute alert:kv_autoscale_flapping 30m reason:"flapping during canary" notify:team-infra
```

Kai: Heads up — routing fallback rule that kicks in around 95th percentile has been slightly more aggressive since we tuned it last week. Might explain the spike in fallback-rate alerts and some tail latency. Opening a quick config PR to relax threshold a bit.

Marta: Action items I left: 
- add 30m suppression to kv_autoscale_flapping (Olivia)
- annotate canary on dashboards (Marta)
- infra to review autoscale thresholds (Leo -> infra-team)
- if encoder alloc failures >10/min for 30 consecutive minutes, escalate (Olivia/Kai)

OncallBot: Reminder: please update the nightly handoff doc with any watchlist items — https://docs.redwood.dev/ops/handoffs

Olivia: Acked. I'll update the handoff and drop a short note in #eng-oncall under "coverage-signal-flare-1845324000". Leaving coverage now — will check in 20m and hand off to Leo if still noisy. :thumbsup:

Leo: Thanks — I'll be on deck after Olivia. If anything noisy persists past the suppression window I'll open a follow-up thread and escalate.

Marta: Thanks all, leaving now. FYI — not urgent but wanted to reduce pager churn. :coffee:
